page_title: PeriPage.js — Bluetooth Label Printing in Your Browser
printer_intro: Connect your PeriPage to see its battery and device information.
printer_shared_hint: Keep the tab connected to the printer open. Disconnecting here disconnects the printer for all tabs.
printer_choose_hint: Select your PeriPage in the browser’s Bluetooth dialog.
printer_wait_hint: Keep the printer switched on and nearby.
printer_idle_hint: Switch on your printer, then connect it here.
printer_connected_hint: Information was received from the printer.
printer_cancelled_hint: Device selection was cancelled. You can try again.
printer_disconnected_hint: The connection was closed. Connect again when you need it.
printer_lost_hint: The printer disconnected. Check its power and distance, then connect again.
printer_unsupported: Bluetooth is unavailable in this browser
printer_unsupported_hint: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a computer to connect your printer.
printer_insecure_hint: Bluetooth requires HTTPS or localhost. Open the app at a secure address.
printer_timeout: The printer did not respond in time. Check it and connect again.
printer_bad_response: The printer returned an unexpected response. Connect again to retry.
printer_permission: Bluetooth access was denied. Allow this site to connect to your printer and try again.
printer_connection_error: Could not connect. Check that the printer is on and is not connected to another app.
printer_information_hint: Read directly from the printer after connecting.
print_unconfirmed: Sending was not confirmed. Check the printer before printing again.
print_image_hint: Open a label template to print
print_profile_hint: Printing is available for the A6 (IP-200), V1.36_203dpi.
print_width_hint: This printer supports images up to 384 pixels wide.
print_error: Could not send the image. Check the printer connection.
preview_description: Print labels with text, images and QR codes on your PeriPage A6 via Bluetooth. Preview a label template and send it to the printer from your browser.
preview_empty_hint: Open a link with a label template or take a look at the example.
preview_error_format: The template link is incomplete or uses an unsupported format.
preview_error_dimensions: Check the label size and layer positions. Layers must fit inside the label.
preview_error_image: Could not read an image layer. Use an embedded PNG image.
preview_error_qr: The QR code does not fit its block or contains too much data.
preview_error_render: Could not render the label. Check that the fonts and images can be loaded.
preview_error_size: The template is too large. Reduce its dimensions, number of layers or embedded images.
